attrs.evidence: Fable and GPT agreed the Objective Portfolio was v1's largest gap — a factory with no first-class answer to 'better according to what?'. Rather than specify one for a hypothetical factory, this record writes the portfolio for the only self-improving process the project actually runs: this loop. Each hard constraint names the round that paid for it AND the gate that now refuses it, because a hard constraint with no executable refusal is a wish. Two soft objectives DISAGREE about whether the last three rounds were productive — SO-CELLS-CLOSED says zero for three rounds running, SO-CLAIMS-SETTLED says otherwise — and the disagreement is left standing rather than resolved by picking the flattering measurand.
attrs.prior_art: AlphaEvolve (generator paired with automated evaluators, evaluated programs kept in a database driving the search) and the Darwin Godel Machine (empirical validation of self-modifications against a benchmark, over a growing archive) are the evidence that evaluators are part of the dynamics rather than a side utility. Neither is a necessity theorem.
attrs.review_focus: The portfolio declares that FAC-OBJECTIVE-EXT's exteriority condition is NOT SATISFIED by this loop: the implementing evaluator writes the ledger it is judged on, writes the gates that judge it, and wrote the portfolio. That is the most attackable sentence in the file and it is meant to be.
attrs.statement: The loop's own objective portfolio is written down: six hard constraints that cannot be traded, five soft objectives each with a measurand and a gaming test, and a named selection rule.
